# Selection through registration / 经识的选择

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-through-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-through-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every selection through a registration selects two histories alike exactly when they register alike. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the registration closure; pooled registration selects an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow reaching beyond to raise what registers is selected.
>
> 两段历史被每个经选择者之识的选择选得相同，恰当选择者把它们识得相同。其余交换固定时选择在识闭包之外不见；所及闭包之内、识闭包之外的终结不被选出，合起来的识选出它；伸出而抬高所识者的流被选中。

## Laws / 规律

1. A selection is any claim about level histories; it goes through a formation's registration up to a step when any two histories the formation registers alike up to that step are both selected or both not, and a score goes through it when they score alike. Registering alike is transitive, so an equivalence.<br>一个选择是关于水平历史的任意命题；它经一个形成直到某步之识，是指该形成直到该步识得相同的任意两段历史同被选中或同不被选中；评分经它，是指得分相等。识得相同可传递，是等价关系。 (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlike.trans`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo.trans`)
2. With no premise, two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's registration exactly when it registers them alike up to the step; its belief is such a selection, so where it registers them apart some selection through its registration holds at one and fails at the other.<br>不加前提：两段历史被每个经一个形成之识的选择选得相同，恰当该形成直到该步把它们识得相同；它的信念是经其识的选择，所以它识得不同之处，有一个经其识的选择在一段成立、在另一段不成立。 (`Becoming.Web.selects_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Web.belief_selects`, `Becoming.Web.separates`)
3. A selection through registration is refuted by its selector exactly where it fails; admission at a step up to the given one is a selection through registration, the level of an observed condition at such a step a score through it, and a score's threshold a selection through it; going through registration survives later steps, more observation, negation and conjunction.<br>经识的选择恰在不成立之处被其选择者否证；到该步为止某步的接纳是经识的选择，被观察条件在这样一步的水平是经识的评分，评分的阈值是经识的选择；经识在更晚的步、更多的观察、否定与合取之下保持。 (`Becoming.Web.Refutes`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.refutes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.admits_through`, `Becoming.Web.observed_scores`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.later`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.widen`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.not`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.and`)
4. Where registering alike with the first history is decidable, two histories are scored alike by every score through registration exactly when they are registered alike.<br>与第一段历史识得相同可判定时，两段历史被每个经识的评分评得相同，恰当识得相同。 (`Becoming.Web.scores_alike_iff`)
5. For a group, a selection goes through its pooled registration when histories every member registers alike are selected alike; the same equivalence and separation hold; a member's selection is a group selection, and group selections are closed under conjunction.<br>一组形成合起来：每个成员都识得相同的历史被选得相同；同样的等价与分开成立；成员的选择是合起来的选择，合起来的选择在合取下封闭。 (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.refl`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.symm`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.trans`, `Becoming.Web.selects_alike_all_iff`, `Becoming.Web.separates_all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll.and`)
6. Blindness beyond the registration closure: with a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what members of a formation's registration closure register, and every member of the part beyond that closure, every selection and score through the registration of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike, as does every group whose members lie within it.<br>识闭包之外的不见：扣留一个部分（其余交换固定），平衡只在一个形成的识闭包成员所识的条件上逐步成立，部分的每个成员都在该闭包之外时，经闭包内任一形成之识的每个选择与评分，把有无该部分的水平选得相同、评得相同；成员都在闭包之内的一组合起来亦然。 (`Becoming.Flow.WithinRegistration`, `Becoming.Flow.unregistered_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unscored_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_all`)
7. Where two flows both balance at each step on the conditions registered within the registration closure drawn through both, have the same formations present, start alike on what is registered, and members respond only through their own registration, every selection through the registration of a formation within that closure selects the two flows' levels alike.<br>两流在对两流画出的识闭包内的所识条件上都逐步平衡、在场者相同、起始在所识者上相同、成员只经自己之识回应时，经该闭包内任一形成之识的每个选择，把两流的水平选得相同。 (`Becoming.Flow.RegisteredFromEither`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_within_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_responsive`)
8. Share among descendants, an application of share_rises: where a selection holds for the history of every parent in one non-empty list and for none in another, the parents it holds for have at least a offspring and the others at most b, and b < a, the offspring of the first list stand to those of the second strictly more than the first list stands to the second.<br>后代中的份额（share_rises 的应用）：选择在一个非空亲代列表的每个历史上成立、在另一个非空列表的每个历史上不成立，它成立的亲代至少有 a 个后代、不成立的至多 b 个，b < a 时，前一列表的后代与后一列表的后代之比严格大于两列表之比。 (`Becoming.share_rises_through`, `Becoming.share_rises`, `Becoming.offspringCount`)
9. In Clearing every selection through the clearer's registration (support only) selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second, and that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's registration at no step; the dweller lies within the clearer's reach closure and beyond its registration closure, and the clearer does not register the habitat.<br>见证 Clearing：经清除者之识（只识支持）的每个选择在每一步都把清除与不清除的世界选得相同，栖居者在前者中被终结、在后者中不然，“栖居者被终结”在任何一步都不经清除者之识；栖居者在清除者的所及闭包之内、识闭包之外，清除者不识栖息地。 (`Becoming.Clearing.unselected`, `Becoming.Clearing.dweller_within_reach`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinReach`)
10. In Clearing the dweller's admission at the third step goes through the dweller's registration and separates the two worlds; both being admitted at the third step goes through the pooled registration of the two, separates the worlds, and goes through neither registration alone.<br>“栖居者在第三步被接纳”经栖居者之识，分开两个世界；“第三步两者都被接纳”经两者合起来的识，分开两个世界，而不经任一单独之识。 (`Becoming.Clearing.selected_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.BothAdmitted`, `Becoming.Clearing.selected_pooled`)
11. In Diversion the diverting flow takes a unit from the source a dweller depends on and gives it to the store the taker observes, reaching the dweller beyond the registration closure; that the store stands at least one at the second step goes through the taker's registration, holds in the diverting flow and fails in the undiverted one.<br>见证 Diversion：转移的流从栖居者所依存的来源取一个单位给取用者观察的存储，伸到识闭包之外的栖居者；“存储在第二步至少为一”经取用者之识，在转移的流成立、在不分流的流不成立。 (`Becoming.Diversion.diverting`, `Becoming.Diversion.undiverted`, `Becoming.Diversion.StoreAtLeast`, `Becoming.Diversion.favours`)
12. The dweller is unsupported from the second step on in the diverting flow and supported at every step in the undiverted one; every selection through the taker's registration selects the diverting flow alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond.<br>栖居者在转移的流中从第二步起不被支持，在不分流的流中每步被支持；经取用者之识的每个选择，把转移的流与不伸出、只给予存储的供给的流选得相同。 (`Becoming.Diversion.favours`, `Becoming.Diversion.supplying`, `Becoming.Diversion.blind_to_source`)

## Conditions / 条件

- That a selection goes through registration (Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a supplied condition written into each theorem that uses it, never derived; a selection is any claim about level histories.<br>选择经识（Web.SelectsThrough、Web.ScoresThrough、Web.SelectsThroughAll）是给出的条件，写在用到它的每条定理中，不推出；选择是关于水平历史的任意命题。
- Blindness beyond the registration closure further assumes the conditions of unregistered_beyond_registration: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions members of the registration closure register, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the registration closure.<br>识闭包之外的不见另设 unregistered_beyond_registration 的条件：其余交换固定（扣留的部分，WithheldLevels）；平衡只在识闭包成员所识的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn）；部分的每个成员都在识闭包之外。
- The responsive form assumes the hypotheses of alike_within_registration: both flows balanced at each step on the conditions registered, the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what is registered, members responding only through their own registration.<br>回应的形式另设 alike_within_registration 的假设：两流在所识条件上逐步平衡、两流在场者相同、起始在所识者上相同、成员只经自己之识回应。
- The converse of the law for scores takes the decidability of registering alike with the first history as a named hypothesis (decided); the law for selections needs no decision.<br>评分定律的逆向以“与第一段历史识得相同”的可判定性为命名的假设（decided）；选择的定律不需要判定。
- share_rises_through: the parents' histories, the lower and upper bounds on offspring (rewarded, unrewarded), b < a and both kinds of parent present are supplied; transmission is not part of it.<br>share_rises_through：亲代的历史、后代数的下界与上界（rewarded、unrewarded）、b < a、两类亲代都在，都是给出的；传递不在其中。
- For the witnesses: Clearing's flows and webs (from the modules of feeding closure, feedback and testing), and Diversion's three flows and webs.<br>见证的结论：Clearing 的流与网（取自喂养闭包、反馈与检验的模块），以及 Diversion 的三个流与网。
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.<br>离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The laws do not derive who selects, what the selector registers, whether an actual selection goes through registration, whether offspring follow the selection, or whether reaching beyond is chosen.<br>这些规律不推出谁选择、选择者识什么、一个实际的选择是否经识、后代是否随选择、伸向识闭包之外是否被选取。
- The more is registered, the larger the registration closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what the selector actually registers.<br>所识越多，识闭包越大、缺口越小：定律的力量全在选择者实际识什么。
- The main law is near-definitional and the blindness a one-line corollary of the theorems of testing-within-registration; the contribution is conceptual.<br>主定律近乎定义，不见是 testing-within-registration 中定理的一行推论；增量是概念上的。
- The gap for one's own act (an act differing only on conditions no member of the closure registers) has no separate general theorem; in Clearing it comes from an instance of alike_within_closed.<br>自身动作的缺口（动作只在闭包成员都不识的条件上不同）没有单独的一般定理，Clearing 中由 alike_within_closed 的实例给出。
- Favouring reaching beyond is stated only in the minimal witness Diversion.<br>偏向伸出只在最小的见证 Diversion 中陈述。 Witness: `Becoming.Diversion.favours`.
- share_rises_through is an application, and its combination with transmission and an open world is a reading; where others respond to the stock a selection rests on, the response hypotheses can fail.<br>share_rises_through 是应用；它与传递和世界开放的组合是读法。他者回应选择所依的储量时，回应的假设可以不成立。
- The formation of arbitrary physical primitives and more general rule-changing capture keep their own scope.<br>任意物理原语的形成及 Capture 更一般的规则变化保留自身范围。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Selection is blind to the gap: in Clearing every selection through the clearer's registration selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second; that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's registration at no step (Clearing.unselected).<br>选择不见缺口：Clearing 中经清除者之识的每个选择在每一步都把清除与不清除的世界选得相同，而栖居者在前者中被终结、在后者中不然；“栖居者被终结”在任何一步都不经清除者之识（Clearing.unselected）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Only pooled registration selects it: that both the dweller and the clearer are admitted at the third step goes through their pooled registration and separates the cleared from the spared world, yet goes through neither registration alone (Clearing.selected_pooled).<br>合起来才选出：“第三步栖居者与清除者都被接纳”经两者合起来的识，分开清除与不清除的世界，而不经任一单独之识（Clearing.selected_pooled）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Selection cannot tell reaching beyond from not: in Diversion every selection through the taker's registration selects the flow diverting from the dweller's source alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond, while the dweller is unsupported only in the first (Diversion.blind_to_source); the same selection selects the diverting flow over the undiverted one (Diversion.favours).<br>选择分不出伸出与否：Diversion 中经取用者之识的每个选择把从栖居者的来源转移的流与只给予存储、不伸出的供给的流选得相同，而栖居者只在前者中不被支持（Diversion.blind_to_source）；同一选择选中转移的流而不选不分流的流（Diversion.favours）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)

## Next / 下一步

The gap for one's own act as a general theorem: where an act differs only on conditions no member of the registration closure registers, every selection through it misses the act; favouring reaching beyond in general: when a part raising what registers must reach beyond the closure; with transmission, descent and openness (Capture's descent_needs_unrun), the rising share of what reaches beyond.<br>自身动作的缺口作为一般定理：动作只在识闭包成员都不识的条件上不同时，经其识的每个选择都看不见它；偏向伸出的一般形式：抬高所识者的部分何时必伸出识闭包之外；与传递、后代和开放（Capture 的 descent_needs_unrun）组合，陈述伸出者份额的上升。

### Correspondence / 对应

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?” and pasted an explanation of causal systems of unstated authorship (neither Ren's wording nor a premise); after the AI's comparison and its five proposals, Ren wrote “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This record is the first of them. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): any selection decided by what a selector registers (keeping, rewarding, reproducing, training) reaches exactly what it registers, blind to whatever a candidate's part does beyond the selector's registration closure, however far its reach closure extends; the gap is the reach closure less the registration closure, closing only through dependence, observation or another's registration pooled; where reaching beyond raises what registers, selection favours it, and with share_rises the share of what reaches beyond rises while the world is open; for AI training, a reward process is a selector and training reaches only what the reward registers. The AI, on its own account, connects this with the title of Ren's paper “When Capability Outruns Correction”. See §86 of the integration note.<br>2026-10-12，Ren 问“hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?”，并贴入一段作者未注明的因果系统说明（不是 Ren 的话，也不是前提）；AI 作比较并提出五项可学之处后，Ren 写“Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”。本记录是其中第一项，五项提议是 AI 的。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：任何由选择者所识决定的选择（保留、奖励、繁殖、训练）恰及选择者所识，对候选者的部分在选择者识闭包之外所做的不见，无论其所及闭包延伸多远；缺口是所及闭包减去识闭包，只经依存、观察或他者之识合起来才合上；伸出而抬高所识者之处，选择偏向它，连同 share_rises，伸出者的份额在世界开放时上升；以 AI 训练读，奖励过程是选择者，训练只及奖励所识。AI 把这与 Ren 一篇论文的标题 “When Capability Outruns Correction” 相接；这是 AI 的联系。见整合文档 §86。

  - Input / 输入: 选择所成立的亲代的份额上升。 / The share of the parents a selection holds for rises.
  - Preserved conditions / 保留条件: 后代数的界与 b < a 是给出的；两类亲代都在。 / The bounds on offspring and b < a are supplied; both kinds of parent present. [Capture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Capture.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [runaway-distance-unregistered](runaway-distance-unregistered.md). 那里经识的策略不能用上它所不识的储量；这里经识的选择不能对它所不识的部分作出选择。 / There a policy through registration cannot use a stock it does not register; here a selection through registration cannot select on a part it does not register.
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [evolution-on-descent](evolution-on-descent.md). 那里 Price 方程的计数形式不陈述选择项；P62 给出份额的上升，这里由经识的选择给出携带者（应用）。 / There the counting form of Price's equation leaves the selection term unstated; P62 gives the rise of a share, and here a selection through registration supplies the carriers (an application).
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [selection-under-registration-revision](selection-under-registration-revision.md). P93 完成登记改变时的选择保留／损失条件及实际局部重构；配方自身取得和更一般捕获仍开放。 / P93 completes choice preservation/loss under registration change and local executed reconstruction; acquired recipes and general capture remain open.
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [selection-through-a-model-of-the-options](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.md). 同一形式的律：经识的选择恰及所识，经模型的选择恰分开模型所分开者；模型使两个选项并列时，每个经模型的选择都选得相同。 / A law of the same form: selection through registration reaches exactly what registers, and selection through a model separates exactly what the model separates; where the model ties two options, every selection through it selects them alike.
